remarks: Unique 12 character string containing alphanumerical values for each analysis
Unique alphanumeric character string that is used to unambiguously identify a particular record in the Mouse Genome Informatics database
Official mouse gene symbol in title format; alphanumeric
Name of mouse strain. Values are B6Brd;B6Dnk;B6N-Tyr<c-Brd>, C57BL/6Brd-Tyr<c-Brd>, C57BL/6Dnk, C57BL/6JTyr;C57BL/6N, C57BL/6N, C57BL/6NCrl, C57BL/6NJ, C57BL/6NTac, C57BL/6NTacDen
Developmental stage of mice being analysed. Values are E12.5; E15.5; E18.5; E9.5; Early adult; Late adult; Middle aged adult

exampleValues: Forelimb and hindlimb grip strength measurement mean

remarks: Must match gene_symbol, can be used to access more info about specific mutation. Follows standard International Committee on Standardized Genetic Nomenclature for Mice; must have properly closed parentheses and angle brackets.
Expression data using the lacZ reporter gene to map where mouse genes are expressed in different tissues. Values are: No data, ambiguous, expression, imageOnly, no expression, tissue not available.
